capabilities.description: Ingests and registers the contract and BOQ as controlled source-of-record documents, with versioning, hashing, and a searchable register of clauses and dated revisions; later capabilities cite these documents rather than restating them.

Parses the BOQ (Preliminaries P1-P5, Earthworks E1-E5) into priced line items with unit, quantity, and SAR rates, forming the measurement base for progress claims and the Accepted Contract Amount used in delay-damages and security calculations.

Builds interim payment certificates by measured quantity against BOQ items, applies Clause 14.3 retention of 5% per certificate with 50% release at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the 365-day Defects Notification Period (Clause 11.1), and tracks the 10% Performance Security under Clause 4.2.

Tracks time for completion of 730 days from the Commencement Date (Clause 8.2) and accrues delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7), with evidence-linked delay events and a running position.

Maintains inspection and test plans with hold/witness points tied to BOQ work sections (Preliminaries and Earthworks), capturing signed inspection records, non-conformances, and their linkage to claimed work.
Answers team questions about clause obligations and BOQ positions, grounding every answer in the registered contract and BOQ documents and refusing to answer when the source does not support it.
